uncertainReason: Released 20 October 2026 (The Fractured Archive, 3rd encounter, alternative to Moia). Infobox 'Max hit: ? (edit)' and the strategy guide gives no number for any boss attack ('large amounts of damage' for the jump); the only wiki numbers are the Jelly minion's max hit 17 and the jelly puddles' 6-8 per tick. Boss rows therefore carry a uniform PLACEHOLDER maxHit 25 (no basis beyond 'large'); unknown uncounted hazards are 0. The per-kill shares of the HP-triggered specials come from an assumed ~110 four-tick cycles per solo kill (2,100 HP at ~8 dps = ~260 s = ~440 ticks), shown in each note. Hitpoints scale: 2,100 (1), 3,930 (4), 4,810 (5), 5,690 (6), 7,460 (8); raid page: solo is scaled as two players.

attacks.name: melee (hits everyone around him)
attacks.note: PLACEHOLDER max hit (infobox '?'). Infobox: 'Attack speed 4 ticks (2.4 seconds)', 'Attack styles: Melee, Ranged', size 5x5, 'Aggressive: Yes'. Strategies: 'He primarily attacks with melee, which will hit everyone around him, so it is recommended to range or mage him from afar.' He 'moves slowly around the arena, around one tile every two ticks', and a Scorching bow special 'can root him in place'. Standard play kites him at range, so his regular cycle never connects -> avoidable, never counted. Share 0.86 = the remainder of the cycle after the HP-triggered specials below. If a melee player stands in, this row becomes an ordinary prayed row (Protect from Melee; full block not stated, no piercing documented).

attacks.name: arena-wide slam (at 85%, 65% and 45% HP)
attacks.note: PLACEHOLDER max hit. Strategies: at 85%, 65% and 45% health 'an arena-wide slam followed by three ranged attacks'; 'Each sequential slam will have an additional hit, up to three slams, with three ranged attacks between each.' -> hits 1, 2, 3 across the three slams; hits 2 is the average per slam. Prayer: 'Ensure Protect from Melee is active for the slam, and Protect from Range is active for the projectiles.' -> telegraphed by the HP threshold, flicked; leak 0.1 estimate. Share 0.03 = 3 slams / ~110 cycles (assumed solo kill length). Each slam also spawns 'a lot of jellies' (see the jelly row).

attacks.name: ranged projectiles (three after each slam)
attacks.note: PLACEHOLDER max hit. 'three ranged attacks' after each of the three slams -> 9 per kill -> share 0.08 (9/110 assumed cycles). 'Protect from Range is active for the projectiles' -> flicked (the slam announces them), leak 0.1 estimate. Full block not stated; no piercing documented -> prayerFactor 0.

attacks.name: 'glub glub' jump-slam on a random player (25% HP)
attacks.note: PLACEHOLDER max hit ('large amounts of damage'). Strategies: at 25% health he yells '*glub glub*' and will 'begin to jump towards and slam on a random player.' 'If Protect from Melee is not active, players will take damage regardless of location.' -> not positional, prayer is the answer (flicked, telegraphed by the yell; leak 0.1 estimate). If it lands he heals '(~30-40)'. Jellies he lands on are absorbed and heal him as they combine. Share 0.01 = 1 per kill / ~110 cycles.

attacks.name: two projectiles after the jump (one ranged, one jelly splatter)
attacks.note: No number (0 = unknown). Strategies: after the jump-slam 'two projectiles (one ranged, one jelly splatter) target the player', so 'it is important to keep moving.' Dodged by movement -> avoidable, never counted. The jelly splatter presumably leaves a puddle (see puddle row); its style is not stated.

attacks.name: jelly minion melee (Jelly (Dreadnoth))
attacks.note: Jelly (Dreadnoth) infobox: 'Hitpoints 61', 'Combat level 101', 'Attack speed 5 ticks (3.0 seconds)', 'Max hit 17', 'Attack style: Crush' - the only wiki-attested boss-fight hit. Strategies: the slams spawn 'a lot of jellies' that attack with melee; 'These must be killed as soon as possible as they will drain prayer with each attack, even if blocked.' -> Protect from Melee blocks the HP damage ('blocked') but each hit still drains prayer. Kill fast with Ice Barrage, Blood Barrage or a Venator bow; stack together during the slam phase so they can all be hit. Parallel NPCs (share 0): count them if you model the slam phases - the real cost is prayer, not HP. On his death 'around ten jellies' spawn and the encounter ends once they are killed.

attacks.name: jelly puddles (tiles where jellies die, and periodic)
attacks.note: Strategies: jelly spawns on tiles when jellies die and 'periodically during the fight', dealing '6-8 damage per tick when stepped on.' Positional -> avoidable, never counted.

phases: Slams at 85%, 65% and 45% HP (1, 2 and 3 hits respectively), each followed by three ranged attacks and a wave of jellies. 25% HP: '*glub glub*' jump onto a random player (heals ~30-40 if it lands; absorbs jellies he lands on), then one ranged + one jelly-splatter projectile. Death: ~10 jellies must be killed to end the encounter. He walks one tile per two ticks throughout.
sanityOrOther: Prayer plan per the wiki: Protect from Melee for each slam and for the 25% jump, Protect from Range for the three projectiles after a slam; jellies drain prayer even through Protect from Melee, so prayer points are the real resource. 'Considered a demon with low demonbane values', 85% fire elemental weakness, 40% freeze resistance, immune to poison and cannons, not immune to thralls or burn; not in the 21 October Defence-reduction cap hotfix ('no cap'). Music: Hellatine.
